mapper.sql: sm.store_idx, sm.store_cd, sm.store_nm, sm.owner_nm, sm.region_cd, COALESCE(reg.code_nm, CAST(sm.region_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS region_nm, sm.store_tel, sm.address, sm.latitude, sm.longitude, sm.store_status, COALESCE(st.code_nm, CAST(sm.store_status AS VARCHAR)) AS store_status_nm, sm.cont_end_dt, sm.auto_renewal_yn, sm.store_type, COALESCE(typ.code_nm, CAST(sm.store_type AS VARCHAR)) AS store_type_nm, sm.sv_id, usv.user_name AS sv_nm, CAST(sm.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, CAST(sm.updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at, sm.adress_detail, sm.zip_cd, sm.brand_cd, COALESCE(br.code_nm, CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, sm.cont_start_dt, sm.business_number, sm.first_cont_dt, sm.fr_fee, sm.edu_fee, sm.insu_deposit, sm.cont_deposit, sm.cont_manager, ucs.user_name AS cont_manager_nm, sm.edu_manager, ues.user_name AS edu_manager_nm, sm.cont_area, sm.real_area, sm.floor, sm.parking_count, sm.premium_fee, sm.monthly_rent, sm.rent_deposit, sm.notes

FROM store_mst sm LEFT JOIN code_mst reg ON reg.grp_cd = '20' AND reg.code_cd = sm.region_cd LEFT JOIN code_mst st ON st.grp_cd = '10' AND st.code_cd = sm.store_status LEFT JOIN code_mst typ ON typ.grp_cd = '30' AND typ.code_cd = sm.store_type LEFT JOIN code_mst br ON br.grp_cd = '40' AND br.code_cd = CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) LEFT JOIN user_mst ucs ON ucs.user_id = sm.cont_manager LEFT JOIN user_mst ues ON ues.user_id = sm.edu_manager LEFT JOIN user_mst usv ON usv.user_id = sm.sv_id
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) FROM store_mst sm WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.store_nm, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(#{nm}))
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) FROM store_mst sm WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.store_nm, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(#{nm})) AND sm.store_idx <> #{excludeIdx}
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) FROM store_mst sm WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(#{addr})) AND COALESCE(TRIM(sm.zip_cd), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(#{zip}), '')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) FROM store_mst sm WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(#{addr})) AND COALESCE(TRIM(sm.zip_cd), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(#{zip}), '') AND sm.store_idx <> #{excludeIdx}
